description:
List the individual AI Tracker (Brand Radar) runs for a single prompt — one row per engine execution. Each item has run_id, date (ISO-8601), engine, a response_excerpt (up to 600 chars of the AI answer, with response_truncated when cut) and four flags: mentioned — the brand was visible in this run, i.e. named in the answer OR its domain cited (the same definition behind get_prompt_detail's mention rate); cited — the property's domain is among the answer's sources; for ai_overview only the citation list counts, never the prose; named_in_text — the brand name appears in the answer prose (always false for ai_overview, where Google echoes the query, so only citations count); mentioned_in_text — deprecated, identical to cited, kept for compatibility. Use get_prompt_detail for the aggregate per-engine mention rate and list_prompt_citations for the cited sources. Optional engine (chatgpt, openai, claude, anthropic, gemini, perplexity, ai_overview, ai_mode; chatgpt/openai and claude/anthropic are the same engine) filters to one engine. Date range: a preset (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute from/to (Y-m-d); defaults to last_28_days. Ordered oldest-first; paginated via limit (max 200) and the opaque next_cursor. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// the individual runs of one prompt over the last 28 days
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","promptId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","range":"last_28_days","limit":25}
```

engine.description: Restrict to one engine. chatgpt/openai and claude/anthropic are treated as the same engine; ai_overview is Google AI Overviews, ai_mode is Google AI Mode.

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; omit range, from and to for last_28_days.
